Commentary.Commentary: Staring down at a deficit of 169 runs, England responded well in their second innings. Mark Stoneman and Joe Root held the innings after an initial stutter and after that the likes of Ben Stokes, Dawid Malan, Moeen Ali and Chris Woakes rose to the occasion. The West Indian bowling was exactly opposite of their first innings heroics. They were on level terms, if not ahead, at the start today but succumbed under pressure. Let's see how they fare in their run chase. Stay tuned...

Outstanding session for England! They stretched their lead beyond the 300-run mark all thanks to Chris Woakes and Moeen Ali's counterattacking knocks. West Indies bowling went completely flat in the evening and they were just going through the motions.

Slower ball outside off, Woakes tries to hit it across the line but misses. The players rush back to the dressing room as ENGLAND HAVE DECLARED ON 490/8. They have set a target of 322 for the Windies!

Fuller in length on middle, Woakes flicks it through mid-wicket. They complete one and set off for a second. Bishoo in the deep collects the ball and fires an extremely wild throw at the striker's end which the keeper is not able to collect. Two runs added to the total.

England are going for some quick runs! We can smell a declaration? Holder comes running in from around the wicket. Broad makes room as Holder follows him with a full ball on the pads. Stuart fails to clip and it hits him on the pads and rolls towards slip. The batsmen take a quick leg bye.
Shorter in length outside off, Chris guides it to point for a run.
FOUR! Very full this time! Fuller in length outside off, Woakes drills it through the cover region for a boundary. That went like a tracer bullet.
FOUR! Too easy at his pace. Holder bowls it short on off, Woakes camps back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter outside off, turns back in sharply. Broad goes for the cut but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Lucky he got an edge there or it would have crashed into the off stump.
Third Test fifty for Chris Woakes!
Floats it on off, turning away. Woakes plays it with the spin towards long off for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Lunges and offers the full face of the bat in defense.
Gets on the front foot and pushes it back. Bishoo makes a diving stop to his left.
Strides forward and defends a full ball to point.
Runs in from around the wicket and bangs in a short ball on middle, Broad is taken by surprise. Tries to fend at it but misses and takes a blow on his gloves.
Woakes has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Nearly a return catch! Holder angles in a length ball on middle, Woakes tries to flick but it takes the outer half of the bat and pops out towards the bowler. It goes on one drop to the bowler.
FOUR! Drifts on the pads, Woakes nudges it fine and takes a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. They manage to come back for the second.
Quicker on the stumps, Broad goes for the paddle but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The players appeal but the umpire stays put. Lead crosses 300 now.
Loopy ball on middle, Broad lunges forward and defends it.
Fuller ball on middle, Broad sweeps it and it hits the man at short leg who tries to evade it. That must have hurt but he has saved some handy runs for his team.
Flatter down the leg side. Broad misses the flick and it goes through to the keeper.
Nails the sweep through square leg for a brace.
Tosses it up outside off, Broad drives it through mid off for a run.
Fuller ball outside off,Broad drives it square on the off side for two runs.
Shorter in length outside off, Broad cuts it uppishly towards cover-point for a couple.
Comes around the wicket and bowls it on off, Broad defends it off the back foot.
Fuller in length on the pads, Woakes shuffles across and flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Similar length ball on off, Woakes rocks onto the back foot and defends it.
Back of a length outside off, Woakes defends it from within the crease.
Jason Holder is back into the attack.
Shorter on the stumps, Broad pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller on off, driven down to long off for a run.
A drag down by Bishoo on leg stump. Woakes could have hit that anywhere but he mistimes his pull to backward square leg. Two taken by the batsmen.
Loopy ball on off, turning away. Woakes drives it to covers.
Flatter on off, Woakes goes back and defends it.
Flighted ball on off, Chris drives it back to the bowler.
NO BALL! Floats it full on middle, Broad goes down on one knee and sweeps it to deep square leg for a run. Bishoo has overstepped again.
Fuller outside off, Woakes eases it to covers.
Shorter in length outside off, Woakes cuts it to point.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Flatter outside off, Woakes guides it to short third man.
Works it with the spin to square leg.
Tosses it up on off, Woakes defends it solidly.
Drinks.
Too full in length on off, Broad jams it out from the outer half of the bat to first slip.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Flighted and outside off, left alone by Woakes.
Tossed up ball on middle, Woakes flicks it off his pads to mid on.
Spinning away from the batsman, Woakes plays it late but finds the point fielder.
Flatter on off, blocked from the crease by Woakes.
Sliding down the leg side, Broad tries to sweep but misses.
Lunges to a full ball and blocks it safely.
Flighted ball on off, Broad tries playing across the line but misses.
Full and on middle, knocked down to long on for one.
Bowls it with a round-arm action and lands it on off, Woakes defends it from the back foot.
Flighted and full outside off, Woakes presses forward and pushes it to covers.
Leans forward to bring his bat and pad together in defense.
Moves on the back foot and defends it back to the bowler.
Goes on the back foot and turns it through mid-wicket for a run.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Good effort by the fielder. Short and wide outside off, Woakes plays a late cut and gets it past short third man. Powell gives the chase and slides near the fence to pull it back. The umpire checks upstairs and the replays weren't much conclusive. Anyway, the third umpire feels it was cleanly done. Two runs added to the total.
Floated ball on middle, Woakes defends it back off the front foot.

Fuller in length on off, Woakes gets on the front foot and eases it down to long on for one. 450 up for England. That's remarkable in many, many ways. Remember, they started this innings with a deficit of 169 runs. Big effort, this.
A nicely tossed up ball on off, from around the wicket, Woakes sticks back and defends it to the off side.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it through cover-point for a single.
Probably a slider around middle, Broad tries defending but it goes off the inside edge to short fine leg.
Flatter and fuller on off, Broad defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Off the pair with a boundary! Flighted full ball on off, Broad plays a neat lap sweep first up and finds the fence at long leg.
Stuart Broad strides out to the middle.

OUT! Moeen holes out! Tossed up ball on off, spinning back in, Ali tries to slog it across the line over mid-wicket but gets a top edge down to long on. A safe catch by Kraigg Brathwaite in the deep to end an outstanding partnership which was worth 117 runs. Moeen returns to the pavilion amidst a roar from the crowd. England lead by 275 runs!
Short and wide outside off, Woakes cracks it off his back foot through point for one.
A googly landing outside off, not turning in much as Woakes leaves it alone.
Slower full ball on off, Moeen gets forward with a big stretch and drives it through covers for three runs.
Flighted ball on off, Moeen defends it near his front pad.
Taps it down to short third man and takes a single. Slight fumble but no extra run taken.
Lunges and pushes it with soft hands to point for one. Two singles in the over, the scoreboard keeps ticking.
A slider on off, staying low, Woakes keeps his eyes on the ball and defends it to the leg side.
Loopy around off, defended back to the bowler.
Full toss on middle, Moeen uses his wrists and flicks it through mid-wicket for one. Would be disappointed for not putting it away.
Shortish and on off, Moeen gets back and eases it towards cover-point.
Tossed up and outside off, left alone.
Loopy and on middle, Woakes lunges and defends it back from the inner half of the bat.
Fullish and on middle, Woakes hits it down the ground but finds Holder at mid on.
Quicker one, full and on off, Woakes is on the front foot as he defends it to the off side.
Flatter this time, a little short and on off, Woakes goes back and defends it down.
Fuller and wider on off, Moeen walks forward and nudges it down to long on for one.
Loopy full ball on off, Moeen presses forward and defends it back.
Short and on middle, Woakes goes back and works it to square leg.
Gets back and punches it through mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! Easy pickings! A little short in length around off, Moeen goes deep inside the crease and cracks it through backward point for another boundary. It seems West Indies have given up! No real intent in the field.
Turning away from the batsman from a shorter length outside off, Moeen tries to cut but misses. Good take by Dowrich with one hand.
Ali has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! What a shot! Chase tosses it up in the air and serves a full ball wide outside off, Moeen latches onto it and thrashes it through extra cover.
Gives it some extra air and lands it full on off, Woakes defends it from the inner half of the bat to short leg.
Drifting into the batsman on off, Woakes digs it out to covers.
Short and wide outside off, cut straight to point.
Flighted and full on off, Chris is on the front foot in defense.
Short and outside off, punched from the back foot but straight to the cover fielder.
Floated leg spinner outside off, left alone.
100-run stand between Moeen Ali and Chris Woakes.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Loopy and on off, spinning in, Moeen is down on one knee in a flash and sweeps it sweetly through square leg for a boundary. A century stand to push the Windies in a corner!
Beauty! Some extra rip on this one, landing on off and spinning away to beat Moeen's bat who was attempting to defend off the front foot.
Loopy and outside off, Moeen takes a stride forward to cover the spin and then leaves it alone.
FOUR! A full toss this time, outside off, Moeen takes a stride forward and nails his drive through extra cover for a boundary. The long off fielder had no chance.
Nicely tossed up ball on off, again defended off the front foot by Ali.
Loopy full ball on off, Moeen is on the front foot in defense.
Tossed up ball on off, spinning away, Woakes tries to defend off the front foot but is beaten by the away spin.
Flighted and full on middle, Moeen flicks it through mid-wicket and takes a single. England lead by 250 runs!
Wrong 'un outside off, Moeen plays for the spin and gets beaten.
Short and outside off, Ali slashes and misses.
Tossed up ball outside off, left alone by Moeen.

A leg spinner landing on off and turning back in to beat Moeen's forward defensive press. Goes off his pads to short leg who gets excited after catching the ball. The bowler also joins him but the umpire refuses to join the party. Daylight between bat and ball.
Fires in a full ball on middle, Ali flicks it in front of square leg for a single.
Flatter this time, also it's short and way wide outside off, Moeen lets it through to the keeper.
Gets forward and pushes it with gentle hands to point for a single.
An extra fielder comes on the leg side. A leg slip and two mid-wickets in.
Gets on the front foot and drives it through covers for a single.
Quicker on off, Moeen dead bats it near the surface. That's the line.
Flighted and on middle, defended back.
Roston Chase is back into the attack.
Pulls his length back a shade and drops it on middle, Moeen goes back and hits it down to long on for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Slower through the air again, full and on off, Moeen presses forward and pushes it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Nicely flighted around off, turning back in, Moeen gets back inside the crease in defense.
Loopy full ball on off, Ali draws forward and defends it back.
Tossed up ball outside off, a little short in length, Moeen pushes it through cover-point and returns for the second run. All too easy.
A touch short and on off, Moeen steers it through point and collects another run.
Back of a length delivery on off, Woakes goes on his toes and eases it through covers for a single. This is good batting by this pair, always eyeing the singles.
Tap and run. Good length ball on off, Moeen plays it down with soft hands towards point and steals a single. Excellent running.
Remains back inside the crease to a length ball and plays it down to covers.
Fuller in length on middle, it's worked through the gap at mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
12th Test fifty for Moeen Ali.

FOUR! This man has really batted well! Roach lets out a fuller length ball on off, Moeen leans forward and drives it with all the timing for a boundary at covers. Yet another handy knock down the order by the bearded man. England lead by 238 runs!
Throws it up in the air and lands it full outside off, Woakes plays a good looking drive but finds the cover fielder.
Goes flatter and serves it on middle, Woakes gets back and keeps it out towards square leg.
Woakes has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
An absolute beauty! Floated leg spinner, angling in around off and spinning away. Woakes tries defending from the front foot but misses.
Loopy and full outside off, Moeen gets forward and pushes it with an angled bat towards third man. A single.
Ali has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Fuller and on off, driven off the front foot to mid off.

Just short! A length ball outside off, Woakes commits himself into a drive through the line but it takes the outside edge and flies behind. Shai Hope dives full length to his right at gully but manages to gather the ball on one bounce. It's not going their way at the moment.
FOUR! Another boundary. West Indies are undoing all their good work. The game quickly slipping away from them. Short and wide outside off, Chris rocks back and whacks it through point for a boundary.
FOUR! Quality shot from a number 9 batsman! Very full in length on middle, Woakes presents a straight bat and pushes it down the ground for a beautiful boundary. He loves his batting.
Bowls a length delivery on off, Woakes pushes it with an angled bat towards gully.
Kemar Roach is back on.
A googly, probably, Woakes strides forward in defense without reading the variation and gets it away from the inside half of the bat. It hurries past short leg and they take a run.

Flatter this time, landing around leg and spinning down a bit, Moeen tries to hit across the line but misses. It clips his pads and moves past the keeper. The first slip fielder chases it down and they cross for a leg bye.
Flighted and on off, Moeen lunges and defends it to the off side.
Fuller in length on off, driven confidently down to long off for a single.
A loopy leg spinner on off, Woakes draws forward and blocks it with the spin to the off side.
Floated full ball on off, defended off the front foot to covers.
Lands it on a length around off, Moeen goes back and pushes it to the off side. 15 off the over!

FOUR! Runs continue to come thick and fast! An overpitched ball this time and it's driven crisply through covers for a glorious boundary. The fielder in the deep tried his best but to no use. Lead is 222!
FOUR! Sound of no a ball also echoing in the background, yes, Mr. Gabriel has once again overstepped. Short ball is delivered outside off, Moeen lofts it over the slip cordon for a boundary.
Full and around off, Moeen takes his front leg to the pitch of the ball and pushes it to covers.
Excellent delivery and it beats the bat! A touch short in length and outside off, Ali stays back to push inside the line but misses.
Gabriel goes for the yorker but the execution is not proper. Serves a full toss instead on the pads and Ali flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
50-run stand comes up!

FOUR! Classy! A full length ball on off, Moeen presses forward and caresses it right from the middle of the bat. It pierces the gap between mid off and extra cover to reach the fence in a jiffy. Another partnership developing!
BEATEN! Loopy ball outside off, turning away. Woakes tries to defend it but gets beaten.
Floats it on off, Woakes prods forward and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Ali drives it towards cover for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

NOT OUT! A waste of a review. That never looked out. Tosses it up on middle, turning back into the batsman. Ali tries to defend but gets beaten and is struck on the pads. The players go up but the umpire shakes his head. Bishoo wants it to be reviewed and Holder does. Replays show there was no inside edge but the ball is going down leg. The Windies have a lost a review here.
A review for LBW has been taken against Moeen Ali.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

OUT! Oh, no he has overstepped. It is criminal if a spinner oversteps. Bishoo bowls it a tad shorter outside off. Ali goes for the cut but gets a under edge to the keeper who takes it but much to Ali's delight the umpire signals a no ball. The Windies have just not got it right after the break.
So, Kraigg Brathwaite was given only one over and is replaced by Devendra Bishoo.
A touch fuller on middle, Ali tries to drive it through the off side but gets it off the inner half to deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! They are gifting runs now. A full toss on leg stump. Too easy for Ali as he flicks it through backward square leg for a boundary.
NO BALL! Shorter in length angling into the batsman. Woakes flicks it through square leg for a run. Also, Gabriel has overstepped. The lead is now 200.
Good length on off, Woakes keeps his eyes on the ball and defends it.
Length ball outside off, Woakes opts not to play at it.

FOUR! Times it to perfection! Fuller in length around off. A gift to Woakes but still has to be put away. Chris times it through extra cover for a boundary. This also brings up 5000 first class runs for him.
Fuller in length on middle, Woakes shuffles across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Shannon Gabriel will bowl from the other end. He has two slips and a gully.
Slower through the air outside off, Ali lets it be.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Bowls it outside off, Ali opts not to play at it.
Flatter on off, Moeen defends it off the front foot.
Shorter in length on off, Ali pushes it to covers.
FOUR! A very, very loopy ball which ends up being a full toss on off. Ali eases it through the covers for a boundary. A poor ball there.
We're back for the final session of the day. Chris Woakes and Moeen Ali will continue their innings. Kraigg Brathwaite will start off the proceedings. Interesting to see him get the ball.
...Day 4, Session 3...

An entertaining session. England dominated the first hour and it appeared that they will run away with the game. But the Windies made a fine comeback. Roston Chase struck thrice in quick succession to keep his side in the game. The lead, however, is approaching 200 and that should be worrying the visiting team. Chasing is not going to be easy on this tricky surface. A very vital session of this Test match coming up shortly. Do join us in a while.
Loopy ball outside off, Woakes drives it along the ground to the man at short covers. TEA ON DAY 4!
Bowls a leg spinner outside off, Moeen does not fiddle with it.
Tosses it up on off, turning away. Chris lunges forward and defends it.
Shortish ball on off, Woakes pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter in length around off, Woakes cuts it to point.
Drags his length back on middle, Moeen eases it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Devendra Bishoo comes into the attack. He will bowl the final over before tea.
Good length on off, Woakes defends it towards mid on. Two good balls to finish the over by Roach.
Wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. Woakes drives it back to the bowler.
Good length outside off, Woakes opts not to play at it.
A touch fuller, width on offer outside off. Ali drives it to sweeper cover for a run.
Lands it on a length outside off, Moeen lets it be.
FOUR! Not convincing but Ali won't mind it. Shorter on length outside off, Ali slashes hard and it goes over the slip cordon for a boundary.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Quicker on middle, comes in with the arm. Ali tries to defend but misses and is rapped on the pads. There is a stifled appeal from the players but the umpire remains put. Missing leg for me.
Flatter on off, Ali presses forward and defends it.
Tossed up delivery on the stumps. Woakes drives it down to long on for a run.
Fires it on leg stump, Ali tries to defend but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a run.
Tucks it around the corner with the spin for a run.
FOUR! Through the opposite side now. Roach from wide of the crease angles it into the pads. Ali times his flick to perfection through square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! The extra fielder there has not changed his approach. Fuller outside off, Ali leans into it and drives it through cover-point for a boundary.
Shorter in length on off, Ali goes back and across as he defends it.
A touch fuller outside off, Ali lets it be.
Good length around off, shaping back in a touch. Moeen Ali watchfully lets it through to the keeper.
Length ball just outside off, Moeen shoulders his arms to it.
Kemar Roach is back into the attack.
Very full outside off, Ali jams it out through covers for a run.
FOUR! Moeen loves playing this shot! Floats it outside off, Ali goes down on one knee and sweeps it through mid-wicket and into the fence. 169 is the lead now.
Fuller on middle, Ali drives it back to the bowler.
Works it to deep square leg with the spin for a run.
Flatter on off, Woakes rocks back and defends it.
Tosses it up on middle, Chris flicks it to mid-wicket.
Lands it on a length, angling across the batsman. Ali defends it off the front foot.
Shorter in length outside off, Woakes guides it towards point for a run.
FOUR! Beautifully played! Fuller on the stumps, Stokes plays it through mid on and the ball races to the fence.
Good length ball around off, Woakes has a tame push inside the line and he edges it behind. Doesn't carry to gully.
BEATEN! Holder bowls it on a length around off, seams away after pitching. Woakes once again tries to defend but gets beaten.

Was there an edge? Lands it on a length around off, straightens a touch. Woakes feels for it and gets beaten. Holder makes a loud appeal but the umpire shakes his head. He thinks about a review but then does not go for it. A good decision there. Replays show that there was a big gap between bat and ball.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.
Fuller on the pads, Woakes flicks it down to deep square leg for a run.
Chris Woakes is the next man in.

OUT! Bairstow, what have you done? That was needless. Too early in the innings to play a reverse sweep. Chase comes around the wicket and bowls it fuller down the leg side, Bairstow brings out the reverse sweep but gets a bottom edge onto the stumps. The Windies are doing well to chip away at the wickets here. They get their third after drinks and all three have been taken by Chase. Bairstow is dejected with himself as he walks back. England lead by 158 runs. Game on.
Works it with the spin to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Easy for Bairstow! Shorter and outside off, Jonny cuts it through the vacant point area for a boundary.
Flatter on off, Jonny defends it off the back foot.
Fullish length on off, Ali drives it to covers.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Fuller outside off, Ali drives it square on the off side to point.

DROPPED! A nice attempt but could not hang on. Just ahead of a length on off, Bairstow drives it on the up towards the cover fielder. He dives full stretch to his left and gets a hand to it but drops it. The batsmen take a run.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Fuller on leg stump, Bairstow drives it uppishly through mid on and the ball races to the fence.
Fuller on middle, Ali flicks it towards mid-wicket. Bishoo fumbles and concedes a run.
Fuller on off, driven towards mid off for a run.
Fires it on the pads, Ali misses the flick and is struck low on the pads. The Windies appeal but the umpire stays put. Must be sliding down leg.
Slower through the air on off, turning away. Moeen tries to defend but gets beaten.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Quicker on off, Ali defends it off the front foot.
Flatter outside off, Ali opts not to play at it.

FOUR BYES! That has come in sharply and kept on going after it passes the batsman. Holder bowls it on a length around off, jagging back in sharply. Bairstow watchfully leaves it through to the keeper. Dowrich dives full stretch to his left but is not able to collect it and it goes to the boundary.
Lands it on a length on  off, cuts back into the batsman. Jonny tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Fuller in length on middle, JB drives it to mid on.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Length outside off, Bairstow shoulders his arms to it.
Shorter in length outside off, Jonny plays it to point.
Moeen Ali strides out to the middle.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Chase gets another. He has done Malan in length here. Flatter on middle and off, turns away a little. Malan is neither forward nor back and tries to defend it but is beaten by the away turn and the ball knocks the off pole. A very good innings by the youngster comes to an end and he will be disappointed not to make a hundred. Two quick wickets here and West Indies are back in the game. England lead by 143 runs!
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

The pitch has started to talk here! Quicker on middle, turning away and also bounces. Malan tries to defend but gets it off the shoulder of the bat. The ball goes uppishly towards the man at backward point but lands just short of him.
Flatter on middle, turns every so slightly. Dawid defends it off the back foot.
Fires it down the leg side, Malan misses the flick.
Tosses it up on middle, Malan defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Bairstow continues from where Stokes left. Fullish on leg stump, Bairstow walks across and flicks it through square leg and the ball screams to the fence.
Shortish length but down the leg side, JB lets it through to the keeper.
Shorter in length outside off, Jonny cuts it to the man at point.
FOUR! BEAUTIFUL! Fuller in length outside off, Bairstow plants his front foot ahead and drives it through extra cover for a boundary.
Good length outside off, Bairstow shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller in length around off, driven to mid off.
This one bounces! Well, well a lot happening here. Floats it outside off, turning away and also bounces a lot more. Malan lets it be and Dowrich collects it near his chest.
STAYS LOW! Loopy ball outside off, turning away. Malan watchfully leaves it. The ball stays low after pitching and Dowrich does well to collect it.
Quicker outside off, turning into the batsman. Bairstow goes on the back foot and flicks it to deep square leg to get off the mark.
Plays it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Flatter on off, goes on with the arm. Bairstow plays for the turn but there isn't any. He gets beaten and the ball hits him high on the pads and goes to slip.
Jonny Bairstow is the next man in.

OUT! A wicket after the break and completely against the run of play! Stokes just can't believe it and the Windies finally hang onto a catch. Chase tosses it up outside off, turning away ever-so-slightly. Stokes goes down on one knee and tries to go over extra cover. But due to the turn, he ends up hitting it straight in the air towards long off. Kraigg Brathwaite judges the skier to perfection at the edge of the rope. A crucial breakthrough for the visitors, just what they needed. Chase finally gets a wicket. Can they build on this? England lead by 134!
Drinks. A dominating hour for England and they now lead by 134. The game is slowly drifting away from the visitors who are in a desperate need of wickets to make a comeback.
Fuller on off, angling in, Stokes gets forward and plays it off his pads to the leg side.
Good length ball outside off, Stokes taps it down to the off side, in the gap at cover-point and runs a single.
Sliding down the leg side, on a fuller length, Ben tries flicking but misses.
Sharp movement back into the batsman from around off, Stokes fails to work it around and takes a blow on his thigh pad.
Fuller and outside off, Stokes plays a delightful drive straight back and it's stopped by the bowler in his followthrough.
A touch short in length outside off, Stokes stays back and pulls it across the line. Doesn't middle it and it goes towards mid-wicket.
Flatter and a little shorter on off, Stokes hangs back and punches it down to long on for a run.
Loopy off spinner outside off, turning away, Stokes leaves it unplayed.
Nicely tossed up this time, full and outside off, Malan drives it through covers for a run.
Quicker through the air, full and on off, it's defended back from the front foot.
Tossed up ball outside off, Malan cuts it from the crease to point.
Flighted and wide outside off, Malan leaves it.
Shannon Gabriel is seen walking off the field for some treatment on his toe. Shai Hope is also off the field. Shimron Hetmyer and Raymon Reifer are on the field for the two.
Roston Chase returns.
Angling into the batsman from outside off, Stokes leans forward and keeps it out to mid on. Another maiden from Holder.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Beaten! Some away movement on this occasion. A touch short and outside off, Stokes chases it, pushes inside the line and misses. Dowrich dives to his left to collect the ball.
On a good length and outside off, Ben is on the back foot as he pushes it down to mid on.
Pitches it up and wide outside off, Stokes mistimes his drive. It goes off the inner half of the bat to mid-wicket.
Good length ball on off, from around the wicket, Stokes gets back and punches it to mid on.

FOUR! Malan joins in now! A glorious cover drive from his bat to a full ball outside off and it screams away to the fence. 300 up for England and they are quickly running away with the game. West Indies desperately need wickets.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Gabriel is running out of ideas. Overdoes his line and length, bowls it full on the pads and Stokes flicks it in front of square leg for a sublime boundary.
11th Test fifty for Ben Stokes.

FOUR! Stand and deliver! Short of a length delivery outside off, Ben camps back and smacks it through covers for a boundary. Brings up his fifty and the crowd is excited. He raises his bat and acknowledges the applause. Another handy knock from the all-rounder! England lead by 122 runs!
Ben Stokes is facing some issues with his bat. Maybe, some crack near the handle. He is getting it changed.
Solid in defense. Gabriel hurls it in line of the stumps, Stokes defends it back.
Bowls it outside off and tries to tempt the batsman, Stokes is not lured into it.
Play and a miss! A very full ball outside off, probably landing on one of the footholes, Malan walks forward with the drive but fails to connect.
Goes full this time with his length and angles it into the batsman, Malan draws forward and defends it to the leg side.
Brings a length ball back into the batsman from outside off, Malan does well to defend it back.
A gentle length delivery in the channel outside off, holding its line, Dawid makes another leave.
A good length delivery outside off, Malan watchfully lets it through to the keeper.
Holder bowls a length ball outside off, from around the wicket, Malan stays put inside the crease and dabs it past gully. Blackwood chases it down and they take a couple of runs.
Jason Holder brings himself into the attack.
Angling away from the batsman, on a fuller length outside off, Stokes plays a confident drive to mid off.
Sharp delivery, around leg on a length, Stokes is beaten for pace and is hit on the pads.
Switches back to over the wicket and bowls a beauty. A length ball lands around middle and shapes away a touch. Stokes is late in bringing his bat down and it goes past the inside edge.
Oversteps and bowls a full ball on off, Stokes plays a flowing on drive but finds the fielder. Called a no ball.
Very full around off, from round the wicket, Stokes digs it out towards mid on.
A slip has been removed and there are two slips and a gully now.

FOUR! That's a terrific shot, an on drive is a treat to watch! Once again Gabriel is too full in his length and bowls it around middle, Stokes creams it past mid on and fetches another boundary. Lovely timing.
FOUR! Nice shot! Too full in length outside off, Stokes brings down his bat in time and punches it straight back past his partner at the other end for a boundary.
Wide! This one lands wide outside off and further swings away, Stokes leaves it and the umpire exercises his arms.
Play and a miss! Roach bowls it full and outside off, and finally manages to beat the outside edge as Stokes misses out on his attempted cover drive.
Width on offer outside off, Stokes rocks back and slaps it through the line. There is a sweeper in place on the off side and hence only a run.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Stokes stands tall inside the crease and defends it to the off side.
Straying down the leg side, Malan fails to flick and it hits him on the thigh pad. Rolls behind square leg and they steal a leg bye.

Almost identical to the previous delivery, this time Malan gets across the stumps a bit to cover the line and then allows it through. It's been a mixed-bag spell by Kemar, he should consider bowling from over the wicket as this angle is not working.
FOUR! Easy flowing shot from the bat of Dawid Malan. An overpitched delivery outside off, begging to be put away, Malan obliges and unveils a cover drive.
Another one wide outside off and Ben lets it through to complete the over.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
2nd Testy fifty for Dawid Malan.

Fifty for Malan, not a convincing shot to reach it though! A fuller length ball on off, Dawid remains back to defend but it takes the inside edge and goes through his legs towards backward square leg for a run. Not a chanceless knock by any means but he has applied himself better. England lead by 100 runs now!
Length ball on middle and off, Malan sticks back and plays it down with an angled bat to gully.
Angling away from the batsman outside off, Malan shows no interest in flirting with it.
Bowls it outside off, Stokes shoulders arms to end the over.
Stokes reaches out for a delivery outside off and strokes it firmly through the line. On one bounce it goes to the cover fielder.
Identical to the last delivery, once again Stokes leaves it for the keeper.
Gets closer to the off stump on this occasion but not close enough to make the batsman play.
Pulls his length back a bit and serves it in the channel wide outside off, Ben allows it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Oh, what a shot! Roach serves a juicy half volley outside off, Stokes strides forward and unfurls a stylish drive through extra cover for a boundary. So pleasing to the eyes.
Puts it on and around off, Stokes plays it with soft hands through cover-point for a run.
Good length delivery in line of the stumps, Ben is behind it in defense.
A length ball on off, shaping away from the batsman, Ben Stokes offers no stroke and lets it through to the keeper.
A little short in length on middle, Malan goes back and taps it down in the gap at covers for a single.
50-run stand between Dawid Malan and Ben Stokes.
Gabriel lets out another short ball, around leg, Malan pulls it down to fine leg where the fielder makes a tumbling stop. They take a couple of runs. Another vital stand, this.
Loose, too loose from Malan. Spots a short ball around off and goes for the pull shot. A bit early into the shot and hence it goes over his bat. Lucky not to have edged it.
Wayward, wasting the second new ball. Too wide outside off, left alone.
Lets out a grunt and bowls it on a length outside off, Stokes shoulders arms again.
Pitches it up and outside off, Stokes tries to drive through covers but fails to middle it. Ends up pushing it straight back and Roach collects it on one bounce.
Back of a length delivery wide outside off, Stokes allows it through safely.

Chases this time and nearly drags it onto the stumps. Full length ball outside off, Dawid tries driving through covers but it takes the inside edge and goes through his legs to mid-wicket. A single is taken.
Roach continues to be off radar. Tries bowling a full ball but lands it wide outside off, there to be driven but Malan is in no mood to chase anything away from his body.
FOUR! Fine shot to finish the over! Back of a length delivery on off, Stokes stays back to pack a punch. Makes lovely connection and a sloppy effort by Holder at mid off allows a boundary.
Ouch, that would have hurt! A length ball around leg, some extra bounce and Stokes fails to work it around the corner. It hits him near the box before rolling to point.
Lands it on a good length around middle, 88 mph, Stokes gets behind the line and offers a straight bat in defense.
Very full and around leg, Stokes tries to whip it off his pads but fails to connect. Misses out on an absolute gift.
Once again angles it across the left-hander, outside off and it's left alone by the batsman. Doesn't carry to the keeper who collects it on one bounce.
Good length ball on off, angling away from the batsman, Stokes shoulders arms.
Shannon Gabriel will share the second new ball from the other end.
Too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact. Wasted the first over with the second new ball. Line was very poor.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.

FOUR! Roach's struggle continues. This time the line is too straight and the length is on the shorter side. Malan eases himself on top of the bounce and pulls it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Roach has been pretty inconsistent with his lines. This one is way wide outside off, an easy leave for the batsman.  Lucky not to be wided there!
Some visible swing there but the line is inaccurate. Full and sliding down the leg side, Dawid fails to flick and Dowrich with a heavy stomach after lunch dives to his right to collect the ball.
Right on the money first up. Bowls it full and just around off, Malan gets on the front foot in defense. It takes the bottom half of the bat and rolls behind to hit him on the pads.

The men who matter are out in the middle. Ben Stokes and Dawid Malan will continue from where they left off. Kemar Roach will bowl the first over after the break with the second new ball which has been taken. He has three slips and a gully in place.
...Day 4, Session 2...

England head into lunch in a very good position. They have stretched their lead to 82 and lost only one wicket. The hosts started off really well but the wicket of Root helped pull things back for the visitors. It would have been even better if Malan's catch had been taken. Nevertheless, that has been the story of the Test so far. The away side would hope for some quick wickets after the break. As far as the home side is concerned, they would try and add as many runs as possible on a wicket which is getting slower. Join us for the second session in a while.
Fuller outside off, Malan drives it down towards mid off for a run. LUNCH ON DAY 4!
Loopy ball outside off, Malan eases it to covers.
Flatter on the stumps, Malan waits for it and flicks it off the back foot to short fine leg.
Quicker on the pads, Malan works it to backward square leg.
Tosses it outside off, turning back in. Malan shuffles across and defends it.
Clips it with the spin towards mid-wicket and changes strike. 250 up for the hosts.
Flatter in length outside off, Ben rocks back and punches it through covers for a run.
Fires it in on the stumps, goes on with the arm. Stokes prods forward in defense.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Quicker but on the fuller side. Stokes blocks it solidly.
Tosses it on middle, Stokes lunges forward and defends it.
Flatter on off, turning away. The batsman defends it off the back foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bowled outside off, turning back in. Ben tries to defend but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Easy for Ben. Short on the stumps, Stokes goes onto the back foot and hits it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Floats it on off, Malan pushes it towards mid on and sets off for a run. Stokes drops his bat while running but no harm done. A single added.
Tucks it to mid-wicket with the turn.
FOUR! Tosses it up on middle, Stokes goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Quicker outside off, Stokes watchfully leaves it.
Lovely stuff! Slower through the air outside off, turning away. Stokes goes for the drive but is beaten by the away turn.
Flatter on off, Stokes punches it back to the bowler.
Fuller outside off, Stokes drives it towards covers.
Quicker on the stumps, Malan defends it off the front foot.
Works it with the turn to mid-wicket.
Shorter in length, Malan tries to defend it but gets a bottom edge to the keeper.
Shorter in length on middle, Stokes punches it down to long on for a run.
Malan shuffles across and works it to deep square leg for a run.
Tosses it outside off, turning back in. Malan works it to short leg.
Fuller outside off, Stokes drives it through covers for a couple.
Darts it on off, Ben lunges forward in defense.
Fires it on the stumps, seeing Stokes walk across. He flicks it to mid-wicket.
Flatter outside off, Stokes goes for the sweep but gets beaten. There is a muted appeal from the keeper but the umpire is not interested.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Quicker on middle, Stokes defends it off the front foot.
Roston Chase is into the attack.
Loopy delivery outside off, Malan leans into it and drives it to covers.
Quicker on the stumps, Malan goes back and defends it.
Fuller in length on the stumps, Malan drives it back to the bowler.
Flatter on off, Malan defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter in length on off, spinning back into the batsman. Stokes with his high back lift, pushes it back past the bowler who dives to his left but in vain. It goes down to long on for a run.
Around the wicket now! Bowls it on a length outside off, Malan opts not to play at it.
Length outside off, Malan pushes at it but gets beaten and the ball goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Sprays on the pads, Malan flicks it through square leg. The fielder from fine leg runs to his right and does well to stop the ball. Two taken by the batsmen.
Over the wicket to Malan. Angles it across the batsman and pitches it on a length. Malan covers the line and shoulders arms.
Another delivery from wide of the crease. Dawid defends it solidly.
Comes around the wicket and lands it on a length on middle, Malan walks across and tries to clip it but misses and the ball hits him high on the pads.
Slower through the air on off, turning back in. Malan works it towards square leg for a quick run.
Quicker outside off, Malan defends it off the front foot.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Loopy ball outside off, Malan drives it to the man at covers.
Flicks it with the spin to the same fielder at short fine leg.
Tossed up delivery outside off, turning back in. Malan gets it off the inner half towards short fine leg.
Good length around off, Stokes prods forward and defends it with authority.
Shorter in length this time. Stokes stays back in his crease and punches it to mid off.
Fullish length around off, Ben drives it back to the bowler.
Fuller in length around off, inviting Stokes to drive. He obliges but drives it straight to mid off.
Back of a length on off, Stokes defends it off the back foot.
Shimmies down the track and lets a length ball outside off go through to the keeper.
Sprays on the pads, Malan flicks it through mid-wicket and they take a brace.
Drags his length back on the stumps, Ben punches it down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Fuller on off, Stokes flat bats it through mid off and the ball races to the fence.
Flatter on off, Stokes defends it watchfully.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Floats it outside off, turning back in. Stokes lunges forward and tries to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. The Windies appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Might be going over the stumps.
Fuller in length around off, Malan prods forward and keeps it out.
Just ahead of a length on off, Malan shuffles across and defends it solidly.
Back of a length around off, Dawid camps back and defends it.
Good length outside off, Malan watchfully lets it through.
Goes wider of the crease and angles it on the hips of the batsman. Malan plays it towards square leg.
Angles it into the pads, Malan flicks it to mid-wicket.
Shorter in length on the stumps. Stokes pushes it off the back foot.
Bowls a flipper on off, Stokes tries to defend but the ball does not spin and takes a soft outside edge towards backward point.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Tosses it up outside on off, turning back into the batsman. Stokes defends it off the front foot.
Loopy ball outside off, Stokes lunges forward and blocks it.
Shorter in length on leg stump, Malan pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Goes over the wicket and bowls it on a length on off, Stokes defends it solidly.
Good length on the stumps from wide of the crease. Stokes flicks it to mid-wicket. This was also very well timed. He is playing the ball with the angle.
FOUR! That was not too short but he loves playing that shot. Just back of a length on the stumps, Stokes gets in the position and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length on off, Stokes walks a step or two ahead and blocks it.
Holder comes running in and angles it into the pads, Ben flicks it to mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, seams in a little. Stokes walks across the stumps and lets it through.
Loopy ball on middle, Malan crouches low and plays it to mid-wicket. A better over from Bishoo.
Slower through the air on off, but ends up being a full toss. Malan drives it straight to mid off.
Tucks it to square leg with the spin.
Tosses it up this time outside off, turning back in. Malan works it to mid-wicket. This is where he should be bowling.
Drags his length back on middle, Stokes punches it off the back foot down to long on for a run.
Flatter down the leg side, Stokes lets it through to the keeper.
Ben Stokes is getting the grip of his bat changed. He might not be happy with the old one.
Length ball outside off, Malan shoulders his arms to it. A maiden for Holder.
This time bowls it a little wider outside off. Malan need not play at it.
Lovely lines and lengths. He is troubling Malan. Good length ball on off, straightens a touch. Malan tries to defend it but gets beaten.
Wider outside off, on a length. Malan lets it be.
Lands it on a length on off, Dawid watchfully blocks it.
Good length on off, Malan covers the line and blocks it.
FOUR! Gets off the mark in style. Bishoo drags his length back on middle. Stokes camps back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flatter on off, turning into the batsman. Stokes works it to mid-wicket.
Works it with the spin to short fine leg.
Shorter in length on middle, Stokes rocks back and pushes it towards mid on. The man at mid-wicket does well to dive and stop the ball. He prevents a single.
Slower through the air on middle, turning into the batsman. Stokes tries to defend it but gets beaten and the ball hits him on the pads
Tossed up delivery on middle, Stokes flicks it to mid-wicket.
Time for some spin! Devendra Bishoo is into the attack. He is brought on early today.

Drinks break. England started off really well today. The runs were flowing and Root and Malan looked in great touch but the big wicket of Root has just managed to pull things back for the Windies here.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run to end the over, a probing one by Holder.
Full and angling into the batsman, Malan defends it from the front foot.
Much better. Leaves a length ball in the channel outside off.

DROPPED! Slip catching has been woeful from the Windies. Another chance goes abegging and this is a massive moment in the match. Another away swinging delivery by Holder, from around the wicket and Malan fails to resist the temptation to play the cover drive. Due to the away movement he ends up edging it behind. Dowrich flies to his left but then leaves it for the first slip fielder. Maybe, Powell gets put off there and he spills the chance. Poor from Malan as well, this is not the time to be fancy as he just lost his skipper in the previous over.
Beautiful delivery. Full and angling into the batsman, around off and seaming away, Malan is sucked into the drive and gets beaten.
Back of a length ball on off, Malan defends it from the back foot.
Jason Holder is into the attack. He bowled really well yesterday, got the ball to seam both ways. He would hope to get another wicket here.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. Successful over for Gabriel.
Oversteps and bowls a no ball. Fuller in length on off, Stokes strides forward and drives it back.
In the channel outside off, another watchful leave made by Stokes.
Outside off, left alone.
Ben Stokes strides out to the middle. He scored a ton in the first innings and England will want something of the same.

OUT! Against the run of play, West Indies have a wicket. That too a big one, Root is gone. Lead is only 43 at the moment. Another start not converted by the English skipper. It's becoming a habit. His pet shot throughout this innings has brought his downfall. Gabriel bowls it short outside off with the hope that Root miscues his trademark dab. It happens to his delight. Joe leans back and tries to run it down to third man but fails to middle it properly as it was too close to his body. Ends up handing a straightforward catch to Shai Hope who nearly dropped it. Big relief on the faces of the Windies' players as a dejected Root departs.
Full in length and outside off, Root presses forward and defends it towards wide mid off.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
A bit short in length outside off, Root reaches out for it and plays it down with gentle hands to cover-point. A quick single taken. All too easy for the English batsmen at the moment.
FOUR! Roach overdoes his line and length this time, bowls it full and on the pads, Root has no qualms in flicking it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Poor bowling, this.
Short of a length ball outside off, punched from the crease to covers.

Dead ball. Joe Root pulls out at the last moment but Roach was through his delivery stride and bowled it. It hit the timber but the umpire is quick to signal the dead ball. Maybe, Joe was not ready. He was into his trigger movement but as soon as he saw up, the bowler was already there at the point of releasing the ball.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, moving away off the seam, Root feels for it, flat-footed, and gets beaten.
Fuller in length and outside off, Root drives through the line but finds the mid off fielder.

FOUR! Idea was right but not the execution from the bowler. Roach attempts a yorker from wide of the crease but ends up serving a friendly full toss on middle. It's been beautifully put away by Root to the deep mid-wicket fence.

FOUR! Just over square leg. Heart in mouth stuff for Malan! Gabriel angles in a full ball on middle, Dawid fails to control his flick shot and hits it in the air. The fielder jumps but it flies over him and races away to the fence. Lead - 34 runs!
Switches his angle for the southpaw. Runs in and bowls a length ball outside off, Malan stands back and taps it down to point.

Back of a length ball on off, Root goes on the back foot and pats it down to the off side for a run. Gabriel is getting frustrated here, he wants to bowl at one batsman but they are getting to rotate the strike quite easily. Really annoying for the bowler.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Direct hit was the need of the hour! In fact, the replays show that he would have made it, by just though. Full and outside off, Malan bunts it to extra cover and rushes across to the other end. The fielder fails to score the direct hit at the non-striker's end as Dawid dives in. Risky.
Some wayward bowling going on. Once again it's sprayed but wide outside off, Malan shoulders arms and the umpire has wided it.

Well done, Dowrich! Full length ball angling down the leg side, there is further movement as it goes past the batsman who tries to flick but misses. Shane flies to his left and deflects it towards fine leg. A bye taken.

Fine delivery, angling into the batsman and landing outside off before nipping away. Malan without moving his feet pushes at it and gets beaten. The bowler gets excited for a moment but calms down immediately.
Way wide outside off, Dawid makes a leave.
Angles in a full ball on off and gets it to move away a shade after landing, Malan presents a straight bat in defense but it takes the outer half and rolls to point.
Outside off, left alone again.
Got closer to the batsman on this occasion but not close enough. Full and outside off, straightening a bit, Malan covered the line, seemed like he wanted to push at it but then left it.
Roach runs in hard but bowls a direction-less delivery. Way wide outside off, shooting away further with extra bounce, Malan allows it through.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
100-run stand between Joe Root and Dawid Malan.

FOUR! Good shot, well timed by Joe Root! Shannon angles in a full ball on off, Root leans forward and across to flick it smartly through the gap at mid-wicket. Holder gives the chase but the ball wins the race to the fence. A vital stand this for the English team, the lead is now 26 runs.
Gabriel errs a bit in his line, goes full and on the pads, Malan flicks it through backward square leg for a single.
Another watchful leave outside the off stump by Malan. This aspect of his game has improved a bit. He is ready to leave deliveries rather than committing himself to play everything.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Taps it down to covers and takes a single.

Fielding has improved by some degrees for the Windies. Full and angling away from the batsman, Malan goes for the drive square of the wicket but has not quite middled it. A good diving stop made by the point fielder.
Keeps on bowling in the corridor outside off, Malan has nothing to do with it.
Slightly too wide on this occasion. On a length and outside off, Malan shoulders arms.
Fullish and on off, Malan pushes it out from the inner half of the bat to mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off, Malan gets across the stumps to cover the line and allows it through.
A miscued shot! Roach serves a full length ball outside off, Malan tries driving from the front foot but it takes the inside half of the bat and rolls to square leg.
Good thinking from the bowler. Hurls a yorker outside off, Root although is up for the challenge and digs it out safely. Always feel yorker is a delivery quite underused in this format.

Beaten again. This is brilliant stuff by Gabriel, all he now needs is a bit of luck. Lands it full and outside off, Root is forward to play at it with a straight bat but gets beaten. Just enough movement to miss the outside edge.
Play and a miss! Very well bowled. Serves it on a full length outside off, forcing the batsman to come on the front foot, Root tries defending but it straightens to beat the outside edge of his bat.
Good length delivery in the zone outside off, Root reaches out for it and plays it down to point.
Jagging back sharply into the batsman from around off, cramping the batsman for room, Root taps it down with soft hands towards the slip cordon.

Nasser Hussain on-air mentions the importance of having a third man in place on such type of a wicket for Joe Root as he targets that area quite often. He has scored 40 percent of his runs through that area in this innings.
FOUR! Short in length on middle, Root turns inside the crease and just help-pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary.
A maiden over but a harmless one! Hurls it away from the batsman, outside off, Malan makes the leave again.
Not really getting his direction right at the moment, Roach. Sprays it way wide outside off, a very easy leave for the batsman.
Corrects his line but just a bit. Serves a length ball on the pads, Malan works it across the line but finds square leg.
Struggling with his line against the left-hander. Bowls another delivery down the leg side, Malan tries to flick as it was closer. Misses and a comfortable take for Dowrich this time.

Wrong line by Roach. More than the batsman, he has troubled his own teammate there. Down the leg side he goes with a length ball, Malan tries flicking but misses. Dowrich stretches to his right to make the stop.
Roach steams in from over the wicket and delivers a length ball from wide of the crease. It pitches around middle and off, Malan defends it from the back foot.
Brings a length ball back into the batsman from around off, Root defends it from the crease to the leg side.
Good channel by Shannon. On a length and outside off, holding its line, Root feels for it and gets beaten. Working up good pace, Gabriel.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Malan gets on the back foot and taps it down to covers for a brisk single. Big cheer from the crowd.

FOUR! The umpire screams no ball, Gabriel continues to overstep. This time he has bowled an overpitched ball on off and Malan has pushed it with good timing down the ground for a boundary at long off.
Gabriel persists with his line just around off, the length remains full but Malan is content in leaving it.
Angling away from the batsman, fuller in length and around off, Malan initially looks to push at it but then allows it through.
A pitched up delivery to begin the spell. Around off and angling away from the southpaw, Malan makes a watchful leave.
Shannon Gabriel to bowl from the other end. Three slips and a gully in place.
Another delivery bowled from wide of the crease. It's slanted in on a length and Root chooses to defend it from the back foot.
32nd Test fifty for Joe Root.

FOUR! Not in control this time! Root remains on the back foot to a good length delivery outside off and runs it down off the outer half of the bat to third man. Another boundary to his name and he reaches his fifty. West Indies should look to plug that area.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Roach goes wide of the crease and angles in a length ball on off, Root sticks back and presents an angled bat to push it towards point.
FOUR! Third man has been the business area for Root! Good length delivery in the zone outside off, he with gentle hands eases it through the gap between slips and gully for a boundary.
Starts with a length delivery in the channel outside off, angling in, Root covers the line and shoulders arms.

We're ready to get underway. The umpires and the players are out in the middle. Joe Root and Dawid Malan will resume their innings. Kemar Roach will bowl the first over of the day. He has two slips and  two men in the gully region for Root.

The momentum now is with the home side but an early wicket or two will turn it into the away sides' favor. That is exactly what Holder will be hoping for. The hosts, on the other hand, will try and get to a respectable total as they know batting last on this wicket won't be easy. We are in for a cracking day of cricket. Welcome to the coverage.

If you ever thought, we would be heading into day four with the match evenly poised then you should be buying a lottery ticket for yourself. England are basically 2 for 3 and it could have been even worse, had it not been for the dropped catch of Root and the missed review opportunity of Malan.
...Day 4, Session 1...

The Windies, on the other hand, started off this session on top. Their captain was brilliant with the ball but lacked support from the other end. His tactics didn't help either. Also the dropped catch of Root might just cost them the game. They will hope they can come out tomorrow morning and restrict the hosts to something gettable. Do join us for the fourth day tomorrow at 1100 local (1000 GMT). Till then, goodbye and take care!

What an intriguing day of cricket! We have had runs, reviews, wickets, no balls and almost everything you can ask for. We headed into the day with the Windies in a good position but the home side has crawled their way back into the game. They have wiped out the deficit and taken a two-run lead courtesy Root, Stoneman and Malan. With a lot of batting still to come, they would look to bat long and stretch their lead.
Fuller on the stumps, angling into the batsman. Gabriel drives it towards mid on who dives to his right and stops it partially. No run taken though. That will be STUMPS ON DAY 3!
Comes around the wicket and bowls a fuller ball on the stumps. Malan drives it back past the bowler. The fielder from mid on hares after it and keeps it down to two. England lead by two runs!
Lands it on a length outside off, Malan watches it go past him.
Fuller in length on off, Malan tucks it towards wide mid on. He wanted a single but is sent back by Root.
Good length outside off, Malan lets it be.
Finally a legal delivery in this over! Length outside off, Malan shoulders his arms to it.

NO BALL! This over looks like it is never going to end. Back of a length around off and middle, Root tucks it towards the leg side off the inner half for a run. He has overstepped again. The scores are level now.

FIVE WIDES! Bangs in another short one but way down the leg side this time. Root watches it go past him. Dowrich tries his best to dive to his left and stop it but he has no chance. The ball races to the fine leg fence.
WIDE! Bouncer which bounces way above the batsman's head and the umpire signals a wide.
A tad short outside off, Malan tries to cut but is beaten by the lack of bounce. Dowrich does really well to get low and collect it.
Tosses it full on middle, Malan works it towards mid-wicket.
Full toss on middle, Malan flicks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Bishoo has been short on a consistent basis in this match. He drags his length back again. Malan rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Drives it with the spin through covers for a run.
Flatter on off, Root defends it off the front foot.
Devendra Bishoo is now into the attack. He has been given just one over so far. Strange captaincy by Holder on display.
Shortish length outside off, Root gets back and across as he cuts it to the man at deep point for a run.
Good length outside off, Root leaves it.
Fuller in length around middle, Joe drives it towards mid on.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Back of a length on off, Root defends it off the back foot.
EDGY FOUR! The crowd goes 'ROOOOT'. Length outside off, Joe tries to defend it but gets it off the outer half through the slip cordon for a boundary.
Shannon Gabriel is back into the attack for a final burst today.
Sprays it on the pads, Malan flicks it down towards fine leg for two.
Length ball outside off, Malan is not interested to play at it.
Fuller in length outside off, Root drives it to sweeper cover for a run.

This is not easy for Dowrich! Shorter and outside off, Malan misses the cut. The ball moves away further after passing the batsman. Dowrich dives full length to his left but can only parry it towards third man. The batsmen run a bye.
Length ball on middle, Root gets it off the inner half towards fine leg for a run.
Good length on off, angling into the batsman. Root defends it off the back foot.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
FOUR BYES! That has not bounced at all! Bowls it outside off on one of the rough patches. Malan lets it be. The ball shoots along the surface and goes between the legs of the keeper for a boundary.
Fires it on the stumps, DM defends it solidly.
Tosses it outside off, turning away. Malan leaves it.
Fuller in length on off, Dawid drives it to covers, not in the gap.
Flatter outside off, Malan shoulders his arms to it.

Fullish and outside off, Malan opts not to play at it. The ball swings further after passing the batsman. Dowrich makes a half-stop behind the wicket and parries it towards short third man. The batsmen run a bye.
Fuller in length outside off, Root drives it towards covers for a run.
Short and wide outside off, Root attempts to cut but misses.
Plays it with the angle towards mid on for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

NOT OUT! That never looked out. A review in desperation by the Windies. Angles it on the pads from around the wicket. Malan misses the flick as the ball stays a touch low and hits his pads. The players appeal and the umpire shakes his head. Holder after a long chat with his teammates decides to review. Replays show that there was no inside edge and the ball is just clipping the leg stump. The on-field call stays. West Indies have now lost both their reviews.
West Indies have taken a review for LBW against Malan. Seems like it is sliding down.
Fires one down the leg side, Root lets it through to the keeper who does not collect it. It runs down to fine leg. The short fine leg fielder runs after it and keeps it down to two byes.
Tosses it up outside off, Malan drives it through covers for a run.
Fuller on the pads, Malan flicks it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and quicker outside off, comes in with the arm. Malan shapes for the cut but then adjusts and pushes it on the off side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Fuller outside off, Root drives it to covers.
Length on off, Root defends it off the front foot.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.

NOT OUT! He has not got an inside edge but the ball was missing the leg stump. Would you believe it? Root has come out today with all the luck possible. Holder bowls it fuller in length on middle, Root tries to flick but misses and is struck on the pads. The Windies' players go up in an appeal and the umpire gives it out. Root reviews immediately. Replays show that it is going down leg. The decision has to be overturned. Root survives a scare. Holder cannot believe it. That looked out to the naked eye. England will breathe a sigh of a relief.
Root has been given LBW and he has reviewed straightaway. An inside edge maybe?
FOUR! These runs will be hurting Hope! Angles it down the leg side, Root flicks it very fine down the leg side and the ball races away.
Fuller in length on middle, tailing back in to the left-hander. Malan flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Slower through the air on off, spinning into the batsman. Root gets it off the inner half on the bounce to short leg.
Drags his length back on off, Root camps back and pushes it to cover.
Fires it on leg stump, Dawid flicks it through square leg for a run.
Quicker outside off, turning away. Malan shoulders his arms to it.
Flatter on off, Malan prods forward and defends it.
Tosses it up on off, Dawid drives it straight to mid off.
Length ball on off, Root defends it off the back foot.
Lands it on a length outside off, Root does not play at it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Angles it on the pads, hoping Root would fall over and get rapped on the pads but he connects and clips it through square leg for a boundary.
Shorter outside off, Root attempts the cut but does not connect.
Good length on off, Root guides it to gully with an angled bat.
Quicker and fuller outside off, spinning away. Malan is beaten as he tries to defend it.
Works it around the corner with the turn for a run.
Fires it on the pads, Malan flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Tosses it outside off, Malan lets it be.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shorter in length around off, too close for Root to cut. He chops it on the bounce to the point fielder.
A third man in place after the boundary for Root. Has Holder gone into a defensive mindset?
FOUR! Root loves playing on the back foot. Shorter and outside off, Joe cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
Lands it on a length outside off, Root opts not to play at it.
Fuller outside off, Joe drives it to covers.
FOUR! Exquisite! Fuller on off, Root plants his front foot forward and drives it through covers for a boundary. How costly will that drop catch prove?
Fuller in length outside off, Root lets it be.
Jason Holder back into the attack. Can he provide the breakthrough?
Fuller on off, Dawid drives it to the man at covers.
Quicker on middle, Malan prods forward and defends it.
Plays the paddle sweep through short fine leg and picks up a couple.
Flatter outside off, Dawid keeps his eyes on the ball and leaves it.
Fires it on off, Malan defends it off the front foot.
Bowls a loopy ball outside off from over the wicket. Malan lets it through to the keeper.
Bowls it from wide of the crease on off, Root tucks it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, Root pushes it off the back foot to covers.
Fires it wide outside off, Root watchfully leaves it to the keeper.
FOUR! Easy-peasy! Angles it into the pads, Root uses the pace of the ball and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter in length around off, Root guides it to gully.
Lands it on a length on off, Root defends it towards mid off.
Bowls it outside off, Malan lets it be.
Loopy ball outside off, Malan does not fiddle with it.
Drags his length back outside off, Dawid cuts it to point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter in length outside off, Malan first looks to cut but then seeing the extra turn and bounce pulls out of the shot.
Slower through the air outside off, Malan opts not to play at it.
Shorter in length outside off, Root plays it to point.
FOUR! This what you get for dropping a world class player! A tad fuller on off, Root drives it through covers for a boundary.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length on off, Root defends it solidly.
Length outside off, Root shoulders his arms to it.

DROPPED! Kyle Hope, what have you done? Root is not the man you should drop. Root got a life in the first innings and he gets one again. Shortish outside off, Root tries to force it through the off side but gets an outside edge which flies to gully who spills it. The fielder next to him picks the ball up and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but the batsman has made his ground. Plenty of action on one ball but no success for West Indies.
Drags his length back outside off, Malan cuts it to point.
Wider of off, Dawid lets it be.
Floats it outside off, turning away. Malan shoulders his arms to it.
Works it with the spin to deep square leg for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Malan cuts it towards point where the fielder fumbles and concedes a run.
Tosses it up on off, Malan defends it watchfully.
Roston Chase comes into the attack.
Time for Drinks.
Shorter in length outside off, Root camps back and tries to force it through the off side but does not connect.
Back of a length outside off, Root feels for it but gets beaten.
Length on off, Root defends it solidly.
FOUR! POOR LENGTH! Short and wide outside off, Root goes back and across and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Shorter in length, Malan pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
Sprays it down the leg side, Root flicks it towards fine leg for a run.
Wide outside off, Malan shoulders his arms to it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Was there an edge there? Length ball, pitched on leg stump, swinging away. Malan tries to defend but misses and it goes through to the keeper. The Windies make a stifled appeal but the umpire remains put. There was a sound as it passed the bat and there you go, there was a spike on Ultra Edge as it passes the bat. They had a review left and they could have used it there. Malan should consider himself lucky.
FOUR! Nicely timed! Malan just uses the pace. Gabriel bowls it fuller on off, Dawid drives it through mid off. The ball races down the slope  for a boundary.
Dishes out a full on off, Malan defends it solidly.
Bowls a full toss down the leg side, Malan misses the flick and it goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Just short of a length outside off, Root pushes it towards point.
Fuller in length outside off, Root is in no mood to play at it.
Shortish length on off, Root camps back and pushes it to mid off.
Shorter in length on off, Root punches it off the back foot.
Lands it outside off, Root leaves it alone.

Back of a length on off, Root tries to defend it but gets it off the outer half towards gully who dives to his right and makes a good stop. So many times in Birmingham you saw those  hit the hands of the fielder and go down to the fence but not here.
Lands it on a length on off, Malan defends it off the front foot. A successful over for Gabriel!
Angles it on the pads, Malan flicks it to mid-wicket.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Dawid Malan is the next man in.

OUT! TIMBER! What a delivery from the pacer. An absolute peach. Gabriel comes steaming in and angles it into the batsman from around the wicket. Pitches it outside off, and gets it to straighten after landing. Stoneman gets squared up while trying to defend it and misses it. The ball hits the top of off after going past the edge of the bat. The umpire asks Stoneman to wait as he wants to check for the no ball. Replays show that Gabriel's foot is JUST fine. Mark, the youngster, after a good innings is walking back. England are in trouble here, they are three down now, trailing by 75 runs.
Stoneman has been knocked over but the umpire has asked him to wait as they want to check the no ball. Has Gabriel overstepped again?
Good length outside off, Stoneman first thinks about playing it and then lets it through.
NO BALL! Angles it down the leg side, Stoneman fails to flick it and it goes through to the keeper. A no ball signalled as Gabriel has overstepped.
Bowls a very full delivery on the stumps, from around the wicket. Stoneman does well to jam it out to mid on.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Back of a length outside off, Root guides it to point.

FOUR! Root gets off the mark with a boundary. Roach serves him with a full ball on leg stump. Root flicks it through square leg and the ball races to the fence. He scores his first runs on his 21st ball.
Lands it on a length outside off, Root opts not to play at it.
Roach bowls it from wide of the crease and spears it into the batsman. Root tries to defend but misses and the ball hits him high on his pads.
Shorter on the body of the batsman. Stoneman pulls it down to fine leg for a run. The crowd makes a loud cheer as it is the first run after five overs.
Good length outside off, Root is in no mood to play at it. Five maidens in row.
A good length around off, Root tries to work it down to third man. The fielder at gully dives to his right and makes a good stop. Root is still not off the mark here.
Back of a length on off, Root defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Close shave! Root must have had his heart in his mouth as soon as he played that shot. Fuller on middle, straightens a touch. Root tries to work it on the leg side but gets an outside edge which falls short of first slip. The fielder does well to stop it. That would have been the wicket the Windies so desperately wanted.
Shannon from wide of the crease, fires a full ball on the stumps. Root eases it to mid on.
Back of a length on off, Stoneman camps back and defends it.
Lands it on a length around off, angling away. Stoneman lets it be.
Length ball on off, Mark prods forward and blocks it.
Dishes a ball wide outside off, Stoneman does not fiddle with it.
Back of a length on middle, Stoneman plays it towards point.
Fullish outside off, Stoneman drives it to mid off.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
A touch fuller in length outside off, Root plants his front foot ahead and lets it through.
Fuller in length on off, Joe drives it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, angling into the batsman. Root defends it towards mid on.
Good length outside off, Root points his bat skywards and lets it through to the keeper.
JAFFA! Almost the perfect delivery. Good length around off, seams away after pitching. Root pokes at it and gets beaten.
Bangs in a quick short ball on off, Stoneman does really well to keep it down and guide it to gully.
Good length outside off, swings away and dips after going past the batsman. Dowrich does well to collect it.
Fuller in length outside off, Stoneman opts not to play at it.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Length on off, Stoneman gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Good length on off, angling across the batsman. Stoneman shoulders his arms to it.
Kemar Roach is brought back into the attack.
Bowls it on a length outside off, Root points his bat skywards and lets it through.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Lands it on a length outside off, Root does not play at it.
Good length on off, gets some outward movement. Root guides it to gully.
Length on off, Root defends it watchfully.
A yorker on off, Root does well to dig it out.
Maiden Test fifty for Mark Stoneman.

FOUR! A perfect ball for him to get to his fifty. Sprays it on the pads, Stoneman flicks it fine down the leg side for a boundary. He has played a very important knock here  and would want to get a big one.
Fuller in length on off, Stoneman drives it to mid off.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Bowls it outside off, Stoneman shoulders his arms to it.
Angles it into the batsman, Stoneman tries to defend it but goes off the outside edge on the bounce towards covers.
Beauty! Lands it on a length from around the wicket, just outside off, Stoneman tries to defend it but gets beaten. Very, very close to the outside edge.
A touch short and around off, Stoneman jumps and turns it down to deep backward square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, a gentle delivery, Stoneman gets forward and defends it watchfully to the off side.
Fullish and on off, defended solidly towards mid on.
